versions.changelog:
Initial release of ClickUp Ticket Manager (clup):

- Provides a command-line tool for creating quality ClickUp tasks with clear titles and detailed descriptions.
- Enforces minimum description standards (2–3 sentences with context and purpose).
- Supports ticket creation with options for priority and custom tags.
- Prompts users for more information if input is vague.
- Displays the ClickUp URL after successful ticket creation.
- Default tags and status are configurable; help available via `clup --help`.
